title: Breakfast Time
description: Three short recordings about breakfast food and drinks.
instructions: Read the questions first. Then press Play and listen. Choose the best answer for each question.

parts.title: Part 1 · In the kitchen
parts.intro: You will hear Mum and Ben at breakfast.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Good morning, Ben! Are you hungry?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Yes, Mum! I want eggs and toast.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Do you want milk or juice?

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Juice, please. I do not like milk.

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Here you are. Eat it all!

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Thank you, Mum. It is yummy!

script.speaker: Ben
script.text: Mum, is there any more toast?

script.speaker: Mum
script.text: Yes, here are two more pieces. Be careful, they are hot.

parts.title: Part 2 · Linh's breakfast
parts.intro: You will hear Linh talking about her breakfast.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: I have rice and a banana for breakfast.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: I drink hot milk. My little sister has an apple.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: We eat at seven o'clock.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: After breakfast, I brush my teeth and go to school.

script.speaker: Linh
script.text: I like breakfast. It is the best meal of the day.

parts.title: Part 3 · A hungry boy
parts.intro: You will hear Nam and his grandmother.

script.speaker: Grandma
script.text: Nam, do you want some bread?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Yes, please, Grandma. With jam.

script.speaker: Grandma
script.text: We have strawberry jam and orange jam.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: Strawberry, please. It is my favourite!

script.speaker: Grandma
script.text: Here is your bread. Do you want tea?

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: No, thank you. I want water.

script.speaker: Grandma
script.text: Eat slowly, Nam. We have a lot of time.

script.speaker: Nam
script.text: OK, Grandma. The bread is very good today.

questions.text: What does Ben want to eat?
questions.explanation: Ben says, "I want eggs and toast."
Ben chooses juice because he does not like milk.

questions.explanation: Nam says strawberry is his favourite.
